note: Graded queries for the retrieval benchmark, run in the session's project github.com/example/ledger. Each names its target (grade 2) and may name related memories (grade 1). direct shares words with the target; task is how an agent asks in the middle of work; paraphrase says the same with little or no shared wording. A query of a case counts a win apart: superseded, when none of its excluded memories (each replaced by its target) is returned; exception, when its target, a project's exception to the global rule it names as related, is within the default page; near-duplicate, when its target ranks above its rival, a memory sharing most of its words but meaning something else.
